description: Get Slovenian statutes that implement a given EU directive or regulation. Returns a list of Slovenian statutes with their implementation status, showing which laws transpose the EU instrument into national law.

eu_document_id.description: EU document ID to look up implementations for (e.g. "regulation:2016/679" for GDPR)

in_force_only.description: Only return statutes currently in force (default false)

name: get_slovenian_implementations
